airport_threshold_probabilities.method: For each airport threshold, probability is the maximum hourly exceedance probability from f001-f024. Hourly exceedance probabilities are derived by linear interpolation across official QMD percentile levels.

methodology: Wind display is the maximum hourly QMD P50 gust across f001-f024. Wind risk probabilities use the maximum hourly exceedance probability for 30, 45, 58, and 65 mph thresholds across f001-f024. Risk is calculated using probability x impact.
